limitations: The theorem does not cover cases in which either type has fewer than two independent parts.
The graph-edge entries are permitted to be zero; strict positivity changes attainment at the outer-phase optima.
No nonreversible, alternative stationary law, finite-horizon mixing, or global optimizer uniqueness assertion is made.
Equivalent specialized results in unindexed or otherwise uninspected literature are possible; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
